source: Hand-made for Control Finder on Oct 9, 2026; not from NIST. Each question is in plain English, and its anchors are SP 800-53 Rev 5.2.0 controls whose title and statement plainly address it (checked against the control text). An answer is right when it cites at least one anchor and doesn't say the question isn't covered.

questions.text: We store customer passwords. How should they be protected?
